Care that starts with a message

This is the patient side of MediCare AI — the same live backend the clinic dashboard uses, in an app shaped for a phone.

  1. 1
    Talk or chat to bookTap the big microphone on Home and just speak in English, Hindi or Telugu — you hear it read back and confirm before anything is booked. Or message the assistant in chat — it checks real slots and books, and a token number is issued.
  2. 2
    Follow your visitEvery step — reminder, check-in, consultation, report — appears in My visits as the hospital system records it.
  3. 3
    Reports & feedbackLab reports land here the moment they are delivered, and your star rating closes the visit.

Try the two-hospital demo: CityCare Hospital and Sunshine Children’s Clinic share one backend. Switch hospitals inside the app and every screen reloads with that hospital’s own patients, doctors and reports. Book in the chat here, then open the clinic dashboard to watch the appointment appear.
